title: CNA25: population aged 15 years and over by age group, principal economic status, sex and marital status, 1981 to 2016
used_for: Design 5.2. The nearest available INDEPENDENT check on the age x economic-status joint after F1054 was reclassified. A DIFFERENT ENUMERATION - Census 2016 - so it cannot share counts with the Census 2022 table the population is fitted to. It shares the INSTRUMENT (self-assessed principal economic status), and the six-year gap means it checks the STRUCTURE of the joint and not its LEVEL: a 2016-to-2022 difference confounds real change with model error. Exposure `none` and nothing is fitted to it.
